items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: But ain't nobody had no shame on Uri. That's right. Shame on Uri, Uri ain't no stuff for him.

ctx.x: He worked there, I think, for a while.

I think he was working there at that time, if I'm not mistaken. I think he was. I can't recall, I mean, who was working there. I remember Roy Palmer working there. That's a trombone player. Talk about getting the gutter trombone player. He was that, I don't know where he is now. But ain't nobody had no shame on Uri. That's right. Shame on Uri, Uri ain't no stuff for him. I'm gonna tell you what I feel about it, you know what I mean? Of course, you know, I hate to say those things, you know what I mean? Because…
How about Zoo? Do you remember Zoo Robinson? Zoo, yeah.
